name: Empathia Village

contractorLicence.verification: buyer should request current licence copy

baseScope: internal plumbing, water, drainage and electrical distribution
walls, floors and ceilings prepared for final finishes
baseScopeToConfirmInContract: selected plot and exact works specification
optionalAtAdditionalCost: tile, marble, granite or timber flooring
landscape design, trees, plants and automatic irrigation
taxesAndDuties: government taxes, duties, registration charges and other applicable statutory transaction costs are not included in advertised villa prices and are payable separately by the purchaser; applicable charges are explained before proceeding
governmentSanctionSupport: Empathia Village assists with the Government Sanction process as part of transaction support; government charges are separate; approval is decided by the Seychelles authority
reservationRefund: if Government Sanction cannot be obtained despite buyer meeting agreed conditions, the amount paid to reserve the plot is refunded; terms and procedure are set out in the reservation agreement
foreignBuyer: Government Sanction process before relevant subsequent contractual stages; decision by Seychelles authority
freehold: subject to applicable Government Sanction and legal procedure
plotLegalDocumentation: according to the project team, project-specific planning and legal documentation applies to offered plots from 600 sqm; available to prospective purchasers and their Seychelles legal advisers before completion; not independently verified for this audit
residence: application support offered; user reports previous clients received permits; individual eligibility and decision rest with Seychelles authorities
rental: owner may choose to let the villa; letting is not prohibited within the estate; applicable licences and taxes depend on intended rental use; no guaranteed return
construction: project reports 70% of plots prepared; first house roof and utilities underway; second house foundation started
priceBasis: Base construction specification before final interior finishes. Options quoted individually.
